about.title: About Me & Journey
about.subtitle: From hardware curiosity at age 8 to engineering mission-critical systems in production
about.profileP1: I am a Full Stack Software Developer based in Belo Horizonte (Brazil), pursuing a B.Sc. in Software Engineering at Uninter (expected graduation: 2027) and working full-time as a Software Developer at CAPYS.
about.profileP2: I work end-to-end with Java (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Data JPA), C# (.NET / ASP.NET Core / EF Core), TypeScript, React, Next.js, and React Native (Expo & Ionic). I have a strong focus on root-cause diagnostics, SQL Server execution plan tuning, polyglot databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis), message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and software architecture (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, and Feature-Sliced Design).
about.journeyP1: My journey started early at age 8, driven by the curiosity to understand how computers worked under the hood while exploring games and servers. At age 12, I wrote my first lines of Python code through Professor Gustavo Guanabara's courses.
about.journeyP2: Influenced by friends, I dove deep into computer hardware and built my own PC from scratch (a Xeon E5-2650v2 paired with a GTX 1660Ti). That low-level foundation sparked my lifelong passion for Software Engineering and building scalable, well-architected systems.

mangaReader.title: Manga Reader (Toonlira)
mangaReader.subtitle: Polyglot Web & Mobile Manga Reading Platform
mangaReader.architecture: Clean Architecture (Backend) + Feature-Sliced Design (Web & Mobile) + Polyglot Persistence
mangaReader.description: Comprehensive web and mobile platform for reading and managing manga, manhwa, and manhua, featuring catalog, ratings, comments, forums, groups, subscriptions, store, and 3 standalone reconciliation/ranking microservices.
features: Monorepo combining Java + Spring Boot core API & 3 background jobs, React + TypeScript web app, and React Native + Expo mobile app.
Polyglot persistence powered by PostgreSQL 17, MongoDB 8, Redis 7, Neo4j 5, and event-driven messaging via RabbitMQ 4.
Full internationalization in Portuguese, English, and Spanish across web, mobile, and backend domain messages.
Automated testing suite with JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Vitest, Testing Library, and MSW.

dbmind.title: DBMind
dbmind.subtitle: AI-Powered Database Auditor
dbmind.architecture: Clean Architecture + Spec-Driven Development (SDD) + FSD + TDD
dbmind.description: Intelligent auditing platform for relational databases (PostgreSQL and SQL Server), featuring automated execution plan analysis, index bottleneck detection, and AI-assisted SQL optimization recommendations.
features: Java and Spring Boot engine inspecting metadata, execution plans, and table statistics across PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
Asynchronous heavy audit processing via RabbitMQ and diagnostic caching with Redis.
Modular analytical frontend built with Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) delivering actionable SQL tuning reports.

debugInsight.title: DebugInsight
debugInsight.subtitle: Advanced Chrome & Firefox DevTools Extension
debugInsight.architecture: Manifest V3 Multi-Entry + Correlation Engine + Zustand
debugInsight.description: Browser DevTools extension for deep frontend inspection: smart console capture, network analysis (4xx/5xx, slow/duplicate routes), localStorage tree inspector, Web Vitals/TTFB severity metrics, and automated error correlation.
features: Automated correlation engine linking console logs, network failures (fetch/XHR), and DOM/memory mutations in real time.
Automatic performance severity classification (TTFB, DNS, DOMContentLoaded) and top-10 heaviest resource charts.
Full diagnostic report export in JSON and CSV formats, with built-in i18n (EN, ES, PT-BR).
